[Story]
The little boy Li Lei plans to use the saved money to go to the zoo to see penguins. However, on the way to the zoo, he sees a toy store that sells electric racing car models. The shop owner tells him that if he uses that money to buy a racing car model, he also gets a flashlight for free. Li Lei is too excited and decides to spend money to buy this electric racing car model.

[Question]
After Li Lei buys the electric racing car model, what does he do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Li Lei uses the flashlight to go to the zoo to see penguins.
B. Li Lei no longer goes to the zoo to see penguins.
C. Li Lei goes to the zoo to see penguins.
D. Li Lei takes the electric racing car model to the zoo.
